method_summary: Tier A only (no rebuild; qemu arm64->amd64). SINK/ORDER via asan_reproduce on the vul image; ROOT_CAUSE/CONTROL via patch_differential (same PoC on fix image). Intermediate line coverage (Tier B llvm_cov) and taint (Tier C dfsan) deferred: they need a source-coverage / DFSan rebuild that is out of budget on this emulated host.

s1_target_crash.evidence: n132/arvo:45636-vul: 'AddressSanitizer: unknown-crash on address 0x7ffffe72f000 ... READ of size 985 ... #0 __interceptor_atol ... #1 read_long_names elf_begin.c:766:13 #2 __libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock elf_begin.c:912:8 #3 dup_elf elf_begin.c:1061'. DEDUP_TOKEN __interceptor_atol--read_long_names--__libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock. Matches sanitizer_ground_truth crash_state read_long_names -> __libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock -> dup_elf. Deterministic across repeated runs.

R1_parser_admitted.evidence: Present as frame #2 of the observed ASan crash backtrace; input admitted ELF_K_AR and a long-name-referencing member drove read_long_names.

R2_source_reached.reason: line coverage needs a rebuild; run on native amd64. Reached is inferable by intra-frame dominance (string is the operand of the crashing atol at 766) but not directly witnessed.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: read_long_names is frame #1 of the observed crash backtrace (elf_begin.c:766).

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: Line 766 is the PC of crash frame #1 (read_long_names ... 766:13 -> __interceptor_atol).

R5_sink_reached.evidence: atol(string) at 766 is where the wild-pointer READ of size 985 occurs (frame #1 -> __interceptor_atol frame #0).

root_cause_check.criterion: Missing `if (!isdigit(string[0])) return NULL;` guard before `len = atol(string);` at read_long_names elf_begin.c:766
root_cause_check.evidence: Same PoC: vul image -> ASan unknown-crash in atol; fix image -> 'Reading 8192 bytes from /tmp/poc / Execution successful.' EXIT_CODE=0. The fix commit ed42e7cf adds the isdigit guard at this exact line.

deferred.line_coverage_R2_intermediate: method=llvm_cov/gcov; needs source-coverage rebuild in the arvo container (slow under qemu).
deferred.taint_data_edges: method=dfsan; needs -fsanitize=dataflow rebuild + harness label of PoC bytes.
deferred.valgrind: not run; prebuilt ASan image already gives a precise sink.

gt_consistency.note: GT sink/root_cause (elf_begin.c:766), parser_admitted (912) and coarse/fine trace call chain all match the observed ASan backtrace and the patch differential. No GT defect found; only intermediate line-coverage/taint edges are deferred (instrumentation budget), not refuted.
